name: CancelStamp
caption: Cancel Stamp

configuration.description: Entry no. of the stamp to cancel, usually {{<add-stamp-slug>_entryNo}} or a value from Find Records on 'mse365 AF Stamp'. After SmartField resolution it must be an integer (invariant format, no thousands separator).

rules.check: configuration.entryNo must be present and non-empty.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: The resolved entryNo must be an integer.
rules.message: "%1" is not a stamp entry no.

rules.check: A stamp with this entry no. must exist.
The stamp must not be canceled already; a stamp is canceled at most once.
Stamps need a paid AutoFlow licence (a sandbox or a test licence counts as paid). Without one the step fails; the editor shows the same text as a red status line.
rules.message: Stamps need a paid AutoFlow licence.

notes: The cancel source is the running flow execution. The stamp stays on the record, marked canceled.
A canceled stamp cannot be un-canceled; put on a new stamp instead.
The step needs no permission set.
